greeting.text: Oh my, isn't it 302? Heading to work~?

lines.text: Did you hear they're inspecting the elevator soon?
My kid just took an exam, and you won't believe it…
It's gotten chilly, hasn't it? Don't catch a cold.
Oh, that reminds me, your parcel came to our place by mistake.
Living alone, are you eating properly?
Maintenance fees went up again. Isn't that too much?
Oh dear, here I am keeping a busy person.

flushRemark.text: Oh my, why is your face so red? Are you sick?

closers.endured: Oh dear, look at me. Off you go~
closers.sos: Oh, you've got a call, go ahead, take it!
